I wrote the quiz to `quizzes/0002.json` and its key to `keys/0002.json`. It has six items on O4, five multiple-choice and one numeric.

- **What it covers:**
  - who owns the control flow, whether the code (workflow) or the model (agent)
  - spotting a fixed workflow among four designs
  - why a fixed workflow suits known steps on a small budget
  - counting model calls on one path of a routing workflow
  - picking which part of the makerspace assistant needs an agent
  - telling a model-routed workflow from an agent
- **Difficulty:** four items are basic (q1–q4), q5 is moderate and q6 is the one challenging item.
- **Ahead of the lessons:** O4 hasn't been taught yet, and `lessons/` has no lesson on it. The quiz checks the objective as worded.
- **Review:** the reviewer found 10 issues in the first draft, and I fixed them in a second draft. I didn't run a second review pass, so v2 hasn't been reviewed. The record is in `review-records/0002-quiz.md`.
- **Misconception ids:** the key uses M1–M9. The workspace had no misconception ids yet, so I made these up. They will need reconciling when the first grades name misconceptions.
- **Cars:** I dropped the car example for the makerspace framing, since the reviewer said it added nothing to the idea.

Do you want a short lesson on O4 before Riley takes this quiz?
